## Merge Gate

- [ ] The branch contains no unrelated work, secrets, credentials, or machine-specific paths.
- [ ] Current remote `main` was fetched and dependency or overlap with other active branches was reviewed.
- [ ] Essential checks passed, or unresolved gaps and explicit owner-approved deferrals are recorded; an unmet core promise is not hidden as polish.
- [ ] The exact integration candidate is approved.
- [ ] One integration owner is named for this merge window.
- [ ] Other contributors know they must reconcile after `main` advances.
